name: M3_PMS100MI_ReschedOper
description: Reschedule individual operations within a manufacturing order by adjusting planned dates, times and related planning options. This API targets one specific operation identified by facility, manufacturing order number and operation number, and can also update the order priority and certain planning attributes. Optionally, you can extend the reschedule to linked operations before or after the selected one, and to lower‑level orders created from the bill of material. The call focuses on changing timing, not on altering the order structure or quantities, and respects existing capacity and planning settings such as forward scheduling, shift planning and bottleneck planning.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order and operation are registered.

inputParameters.name: MFNO
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number containing the operation to be rescheduled.

inputParameters.name: OPNO
inputParameters.description: Operation number within the manufacturing order that will be rescheduled.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the manufacturing order, used as an additional identifier when rescheduling the operation.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity in the alternate unit of measure for the operation; can only be changed when the entire manufacturing order is replanned.

inputParameters.name: PRIO
inputParameters.description: Priority of the manufacturing order after rescheduling the operation.

inputParameters.name: TPSD
inputParameters.description: Defines whether the entered start date applies to the full order quantity or only the remaining quantity when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: STDT
inputParameters.description: New planned start date for the operation when rescheduling; either this or the finish date should be entered, not both.

inputParameters.name: MSTI
inputParameters.description: New planned start time for the operation when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: FIDT
inputParameters.description: New planned finish date for the operation when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: MFTI
inputParameters.description: New planned finish time for the operation when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: MEXP
inputParameters.description: Manual expiration date for the manufactured item's lot on the order, if used when rescheduling.

inputParameters.name: RPLL
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether lower-level orders created from the manufacturing order should also be rescheduled.

inputParameters.name: RPOE
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether upstream operations in the routing should also be rescheduled.

inputParameters.name: RPOA
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether downstream operations in the routing should also be rescheduled.
